function v7Lamps(t){

function v8FlatStrip(m, x0, z0, x1, z1, y, w, mat, tint, role, dir = 1) {
  const dx = x1 - x0, dz = z1 - z0, L = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1, nx = -dz / L * w / 2, nz = dx / L * w / 2;
  const a = [x0 + nx, y, z0 + nz], b = [x1 + nx, y, z1 + nz], c = [x1 - nx, y, z1 - nz], d = [x0 - nx, y, z0 - nz];
  const uv = [[role, 0], [role, 1], [role, 1], [role, 0]];
  if (dir > 0) v8Quad(m, a, b, c, d, [0, 1, 0], mat, tint, uv); else v8Quad(m, a, d, c, b, [0, -1, 0], mat, tint, uv);
}
// vertical wall-mounted quad (screen or strip). cx,cy,cz centre; w,h size; nrm = outward normal [±1,0,0] or [0,0,±1]
function v8WallQuad(m, cx, cy, cz, w, h, nrm, mat, tint, uv) {
  const rx = nrm[0] !== 0 ? [0, 0, nrm[0] > 0 ? -1 : 1] : [nrm[2] > 0 ? 1 : -1, 0, 0];
  const a = [cx - rx[0] * w / 2, cy - h / 2, cz - rx[2] * w / 2], b = [cx + rx[0] * w / 2, cy - h / 2, cz + rx[2] * w / 2];
  const c = [cx + rx[0] * w / 2, cy + h / 2, cz + rx[2] * w / 2], d = [cx - rx[0] * w / 2, cy + h / 2, cz - rx[2] * w / 2];
  v8Quad(m, a, b, c, d, nrm, mat, tint, uv);
}
function v8Tile(i) { const u = (i % 4) / 4, v = Math.floor(i / 4) / 4; return [[u + .005, v + .245], [u + .245, v + .245], [u + .245, v + .005], [u + .005, v + .005]]; }
const V8_STEEL = [.55, .58, .62], V8_DARK = [.26, .28, .31], V8_PANEL = [.62, .66, .70], V8_COPPER = [.9, .62, .4], V8_CYAN = [.25, .85, 1], V8_AMBER = [1, .62, .15], V8_WHITE = [.9, .95, 1], V8_RED = [1, .12, .08], V8_GREEN = [.2, 1, .45];

// ---------- architecture ----------
function v8Ribs(m, x0, x1, z0, z1, y, axis, count, size, tint) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const f = (i + .5) / count;
    if (axis === 'z') m.box(mix(x0, x1, .5), y, mix(z0, z1, f), x1 - x0, size, size * .55, 3, tint);
    else m.box(mix(x0, x1, f), y, mix(z0, z1, .5), size * .55, size, z1 - z0, 3, tint);
  }
}
function v8Truss(m, x0, x1, z0, z1, y, h, axis, bays, tint) {
  const L = axis === 'z' ? z1 - z0 : x1 - x0, c = axis === 'z' ? mix(x0, x1, .5) : mix(z0, z1, .5);
  const chord = (yy) => axis === 'z' ? m.box(c, yy, mix(z0, z1, .5), .14, .14, L, 3, tint) : m.box(mix(x0, x1, .5), yy, c, L, .14, .14, 3, tint);
  chord(y); chord(y + h);
  for (let i = 0; i <= bays; i++) {
    const f = i / bays, p = axis === 'z' ? mix(z0, z1, f) : mix(x0, x1, f), ang = (i % 2 ? 1 : -1) * Math.atan2(L / bays, h);
    if (axis === 'z') { m.box(c, y + h / 2, p, .09, h, .09, 3, tint); if (i < bays) m.box(c, y + h / 2, p + L / bays / 2, .07, Math.hypot(h, L / bays), .07, 3, tint, [ang, 0, 0]); }
    else { m.box(p, y + h / 2, c, .09, h, .09, 3, tint); if (i < bays) m.box(p + L / bays / 2, y + h / 2, c, .07, Math.hypot(h, L / bays), .07, 3, tint, [0, 0, -ang]); }
  }
}
function v8CableTray(m, x0, z0, x1, z1, y, tint, brackets) {
  const dx = x1 - x0, dz = z1 - z0, L = Math.hypot(dx, dz), ang = Math.atan2(dx, dz);
  m.box((x0 + x1) / 2, y, (z0 + z1) / 2, .36, .05, L, 3, tint, [0, ang, 0]);
  m.box((x0 + x1) / 2, y + .08, (z0 + z1) / 2, .36, .12, L, 3, [tint[0] * .6, tint[1] * .6, tint[2] * .6], [0, ang, 0]);
  for (let i = 0; i < brackets; i++) { const f = (i + .5) / brackets; m.box(mix(x0, x1, f), y - .12, mix(z0, z1, f), .4, .05, .08, 3, tint, [0, ang, 0]); }
}
function v8Pipe(m, a, b, r, tint, segs = 8, flanges = 2) {
  m.cylinder(a, b, r, 3, tint, segs);
  for (let i = 0; i < flanges; i++) { const f = flanges === 1 ? .5 : (i + .5) / flanges; const p = [mix(a[0], b[0], f), mix(a[1], b[1], f), mix(a[2], b[2], f)], d = [b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2]], L = Math.hypot(...d) || 1; m.cylinder([p[0] - d[0] / L * .06, p[1] - d[1] / L * .06, p[2] - d[2] / L * .06], [p[0] + d[0] / L * .06, p[1] + d[1] / L * .06, p[2] + d[2] / L * .06], r * 1.45, 3, [tint[0] * .8, tint[1] * .8, tint[2] * .8], segs); }
}
function v8Catenary(m, a, b, sag, r, tint, segs) {
  let prev = a;
  for (let i = 1; i <= segs; i++) { const f = i / segs, p = [mix(a[0], b[0], f), mix(a[1], b[1], f) - sag * Math.sin(f * Math.PI), mix(a[2], b[2], f)]; m.cylinder(prev, p, r, 3, tint, 5); prev = p; }
}
function v8Screen(m, cx, cy, cz, w, h, nrm, tile, frame = true) {
  if (frame) { const t = .06, d = .05; if (nrm[0] !== 0) m.box(cx - nrm[0] * d / 2, cy, cz, d, h + 2 * t, w + 2 * t, 3, V8_DARK); else m.box(cx, cy, cz - nrm[2] * d / 2, w + 2 * t, h + 2 * t, d, 3, V8_DARK); }
  v8WallQuad(m, cx + nrm[0] * .012, cy, cz + nrm[2] * .012, w, h, nrm, V8_MAT.SCREEN, [1, 1, 1], v8Tile(tile));
}
function v8StripWall(m, cx, cy, cz, len, nrm, tint, role = 0) {
  if (nrm[0] !== 0) v8WallQuad(m, cx + nrm[0] * .01, cy, cz, len, .07, nrm, V8_MAT.STRIP, tint, [[role, 0], [role, 1], [role, 1], [role, 0]]);
  else v8WallQuad(m, cx, cy, cz + nrm[2] * .01, len, .07, nrm, V8_MAT.STRIP, tint, [[role, 0], [role, 1], [role, 1], [role, 0]]);
}
function v8VStrip(m, x, y0, y1, z, nrm, tint, role = 0) { const uv = [[role, 0], [role, 1], [role, 1], [role, 0]]; v8WallQuad(m, x + nrm[0] * .01, (y0 + y1) / 2, z + nrm[2] * .01, .07, y1 - y0, nrm, V8_MAT.STRIP, tint, uv); }
function v8HazardRing(m, cx, cz, y, r0, r1, segs, role = 1) {
  for (let i = 0; i < segs; i++) {
    const a0 = i / segs * Math.PI * 2, a1 = (i + .5) / segs * Math.PI * 2, am = (a0 + a1) / 2;
    const p = (a, r) => [cx + Math.sin(a) * r, y, cz + Math.cos(a) * r];
    const u = (am / (Math.PI * 2)) % 1, uv = [[role, u], [role, u], [role, u], [role, u]];
    v8Quad(m, p(a0, r0), p(a0, r1), p(a1, r1), p(a1, r0), [0, 1, 0], V8_MAT.STRIP, V8_AMBER, uv);
  }
}
function v8Megastructures(m, lod) {
  const R = v8WorldRng;
  // cooling tower (hyperboloid-ish: stacked cylinders), vehicle assembly block, antenna masts, skyline band — far outside the playable extent
  const tower = (x, z, h, r) => { let py = 0; const steps = lod > 0 ? 6 : 4; for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) { const f0 = i / steps, f1 = (i + 1) / steps, w = f => 1 - .34 * Math.sin(f * Math.PI * .92); m.cylinder([x, py, z], [x, h * f1, z], r * w(f0), 0, [.42, .44, .46], lod > 0 ? 14 : 10, r * w(f1)); py = h * f1; } m.cylinder([x, h, z], [x, h + .6, z], r * .7, 3, V8_DARK, 12, r * .78); };
  tower(-52, 62, 38, 10); if (lod > 0) tower(84, 58, 30, 8);
  m.bevel(70, 11, 72, 26, 22, 20, .6, 0, [.5, .52, .55]); m.bevel(70, 24, 72, 12, 4, 12, .4, 3, V8_DARK); m.box(70, 27, 72, 6, 2, 6, 3, V8_DARK);
  m.bevel(-50, 7, 40, 18, 14, 14, .5, 0, [.46, .48, .5]); m.box(-50, 15.5, 40, 4, 3, 4, 3, V8_DARK);
  for (let i = 0; i < (lod > 0 ? 5 : 3); i++) { const x = -40 + i * 28 + R() * 6, z = 78 + R() * 8, h = 18 + R() * 16; m.cylinder([x, 0, z], [x, h, z], .35, 3, V8_DARK, 6); m.box(x, h, z, 1.6, .25, 1.6, 3, V8_DARK); v8FlatStrip(m, x - .7, z, x + .7, z, h + .14, .5, V8_MAT.STRIP, V8_RED, 2); }
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) { const x = -68 + i * 13 + R() * 4, h = 5 + R() * 9, w = 7 + R() * 6; m.box(x, h / 2, 86 + R() * 3, w, h, 6, 0, [.36, .38, .41]); }
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { const z = -14 + i * 18 + R() * 4, h = 6 + R() * 8; m.box(88, h / 2, z, 4, h, 8 + R() * 4, 0, [.38, .4, .43]); }
  // floodlight towers around the courtyard and pads (outside the wall lines)
  for (const [x, z, h] of [[13.3, -11.2, 9], [43.2, 15.2, 10], [13.4, 15.3, 9], [69.4, 20, 11]]) {
    m.box(x, h / 2, z, .32, h, .32, 3, V8_STEEL); m.box(x, h + .15, z, 1.1, .3, .7, 3, V8_DARK);
    v8WallQuad(m, x, h + .15, z + .36, 1, .22, [0, 0, 1], V8_MAT.STRIP, V8_WHITE, [[0, 0], [0, 1], [0, 1], [0, 0]]);
    v8WallQuad(m, x, h + .15, z - .36, 1, .22, [0, 0, -1], V8_MAT.STRIP, V8_WHITE, [[0, 0], [0, 1], [0, 1], [0, 0]]);
  }
}
function v8BuildArchitecture(rend) {
  if (v8Arch || !rend || typeof Mesh === 'undefined') return;
  const lod = v8Lod(), m = new Mesh(), g = new Mesh(), ranges = [];
  v8Stats.lod = lod;
  const zone = (name, fn) => { const start = m.v.length / 12; v8Guard(name, fn); const count = m.v.length / 12 - start; if (!count) return; const lo = [1e9, 1e9, 1e9], hi = [-1e9, -1e9, -1e9]; for (let i = start * 12; i < m.v.length; i += 12) for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) { lo[k] = Math.min(lo[k], m.v[i + k]); hi[k] = Math.max(hi[k], m.v[i + k]); } ranges.push({ name, start, count, lo, hi }); };
  zone('centrifuge', () => {
    // ribbed ceiling (under the 8.1 slab), ridge truss, cantilevered gallery brackets, cable trays, hub machinery, hazard ring, guide strips
    v8Ribs(m, -10, 10, -9.6, 11.6, 7.78, 'z', lod > 0 ? 8 : 5, .26, V8_STEEL);
    v8Truss(m, -10, 10, 0.9, 1.1, 7.0, .7, 'x', lod > 0 ? 10 : 6, V8_STEEL);
    for (let i = 0; i < (lod > 0 ? 6 : 4); i++) { const z = mix(-8.6, 10.6, (i + .5) / (lod > 0 ? 6 : 4)); m.box(-6.25, 2.95, z, .5, .18, .22, 3, V8_STEEL, [0, 0, .5]); m.box(6.25, 2.95, z, .5, .18, .22, 3, V8_STEEL, [0, 0, -.5]); }
    v8CableTray(m, -9.55, -9.4, -9.55, 11.6, 2.62, V8_STEEL, 5); v8CableTray(m, 9.55, -9.4, 9.55, 11.6, 2.62, V8_STEEL, 5);
    m.cylinder([0, 7.9, 2], [0, 2.7, 2], .42, 3, V8_DARK, 12, .36); m.cylinder([0, 3.1, 2], [0, 2.7, 2], .62, 3, V8_STEEL, 12, .5); m.cylinder([0, 6.2, 2], [0, 5.9, 2], .7, 3, V8_STEEL, 12, .7);
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { const a = i / 6 * Math.PI * 2; m.box(Math.sin(a) * .62, 4.4, 2 + Math.cos(a) * .62, .16, 2.4, .1, 3, V8_PANEL, [0, a, 0]); }
    v8VStrip(m, 0, 3.2, 5.8, 2.44, [0, 0, 1], V8_AMBER); v8VStrip(m, 0, 3.2, 5.8, 1.56, [0, 0, -1], V8_AMBER);
    v8HazardRing(m, 0, 2, .014, 1.5, 1.9, 24); v8HazardRing(m, 0, 2, .014, 4.35, 4.65, 32);
    v8FlatStrip(m, -9.6, 11.5, 9.6, 11.5, 3.22, .12, V8_MAT.STRIP, V8_CYAN, 0); v8FlatStrip(m, -9.6, -9.3, 9.6, -9.3, 3.22, .12, V8_MAT.STRIP, V8_CYAN, 0);
    v8Screen(m, -9.67, 2.0, 2.4, 1.3, .8, [1, 0, 0], 10); v8Screen(m, 9.67, 2.0, -2.2, 1.3, .8, [-1, 0, 0], 13); v8Screen(m, 2.4, 2.1, 11.67, 1.4, .8, [0, 0, -1], 0);
    for (const [x, z] of [[-9.45, -8.2], [9.45, -8.2], [9.45, 10.2], [-9.45, 10.2]]) m.cylinder([x, 3.4, z], [x, 7.7, z], .16, 3, V8_STEEL, 8);
  });
  zone('skyline', () => { v8Megastructures(m, lod); });
  zone('courtyard', () => {
    v8CableTray(m, 14.45, -9.6, 14.45, 13.6, 2.7, V8_STEEL, 6); v8CableTray(m, 41.55, -9.6, 41.55, 13.6, 2.7, V8_STEEL, 6);
    v8FlatStrip(m, 14.2, -9.8, 14.2, 13.8, 3.24, .18, V8_MAT.STRIP, V8_CYAN, 0); v8FlatStrip(m, 41.8, -9.8, 41.8, 13.8, 3.24, .18, V8_MAT.STRIP, V8_CYAN, 0);
    v8FlatStrip(m, 14.2, -9.85, 41.8, -9.85, 3.24, .18, V8_MAT.STRIP, V8_CYAN, 0);
    v8Pipe(m, [14.43, 1.1, -6], [14.43, 1.1, 8], .12, V8_COPPER, 8, 3); v8Pipe(m, [41.57, 1.4, -8], [41.57, 1.4, 4], .12, V8_COPPER, 8, 2);
    v8Screen(m, 14.33, 2.0, 6.5, 1.2, .7, [1, 0, 0], 1); v8Screen(m, 41.67, 2.0, 1.5, 1.2, .7, [-1, 0, 0], 2);
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) m.bevel(28 + i * 4.2, 3.55, -9.6, 2.6, .5, 1.2, .08, 3, V8_DARK);
  });
  zone('bunker', () => {
    v8Ribs(m, -31.8, -14.2, -7.6, 14.6, 6.68, 'z', lod > 0 ? 7 : 4, .24, V8_STEEL);
    v8Pipe(m, [-31.52, 2.2, -7.5], [-31.52, 2.2, 14.5], .16, V8_COPPER, 8, 4); v8Pipe(m, [-31.57, 2.7, -7.5], [-31.57, 2.7, 14.5], .11, V8_STEEL, 8, 4);
    v8Pipe(m, [-31.5, 2.2, 14.52], [-14.4, 2.2, 14.52], .16, V8_COPPER, 8, 3); v8Pipe(m, [-30.5, 1.75, 7], [-30.5, 6.6, 7], .14, V8_COPPER, 8, 2);
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) m.cylinder([-31.5, 5.6, -5 + i * 5], [-14.5, 5.6, -5 + i * 5], .09, 3, V8_STEEL, 6);
    // pressure-door framing around the bunker door (-12, 5.5) on the x axis, and heavy chevrons
    m.bevel(-12, 2.21, 3.52, .9, 4.42, .44, .06, 3, V8_DARK); m.bevel(-12, 2.21, 7.48, .9, 4.42, .44, .06, 3, V8_DARK);
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) { v8WallQuad(m, -11.54, .7 + i * .8, 3.52, .24, .24, [1, 0, 0], 5, [1, 1, 1]); v8WallQuad(m, -11.54, .7 + i * .8, 7.48, .24, .24, [1, 0, 0], 5, [1, 1, 1]); }
    v8StripWall(m, -31.68, 4.5, 3.5, 20, [1, 0, 0], V8_AMBER); v8StripWall(m, -23, 4.5, 14.68, 16, [0, 0, -1], V8_AMBER);
    v8Screen(m, -14.33, 1.9, 0.5, 1.2, .7, [-1, 0, 0], 4); v8Screen(m, -14.33, 1.9, 12.5, 1.2, .7, [-1, 0, 0], 6); v8Screen(m, -22, 1.9, -7.67, 1.1, .7, [0, 0, 1], 10);
    m.bevel(-23, 6.3, -2, 3.2, .7, 2.4, .1, 3, V8_DARK); m.cylinder([-23, 6.3, -3.3], [-23, 6.3, 3.3], .22, 3, V8_STEEL, 8);
  });
  zone('control', () => {
    // glass-and-steel: skylight band in the 8.35 slab (frames + glass panes facing down) and a glazed balustrade along the power-gallery edge
    for (let j = 0; j < 2; j++) { const x0 = -3.2 + j * 4.6, x1 = x0 + 3.8; m.box((x0 + x1) / 2, 8.12, 25.5, x1 - x0 + .3, .12, 15.6, 3, V8_STEEL);
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) { const z0 = 18.2 + i * 3.1, z1 = z0 + 2.8; m.box((x0 + x1) / 2, 8.06, (z0 + z1) / 2, x1 - x0 + .2, .08, .14, 3, V8_STEEL); v8Quad(m, [x0, 8.17, z0], [x0, 8.17, z1], [x1, 8.17, z1], [x1, 8.17, z0], [0, -1, 0], V8_MAT.GLOSS, [.8, .9, 1]); }
      m.box(x0 - .08, 8.06, 25.5, .14, .08, 15.6, 3, V8_STEEL); m.box(x1 + .08, 8.06, 25.5, .14, .08, 15.6, 3, V8_STEEL); }
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) { const x = -3.4 + i * 2.2; m.box(x, 3.55, 28.12, .08, 1.1, .08, 3, V8_STEEL); if (i < 6) v8Quad(g, [x + .05, 3.05, 28.12], [x + 2.15, 3.05, 28.12], [x + 2.15, 4.05, 28.12], [x + .05, 4.05, 28.12], [0, 0, -1], 24, [1, 1, 1]); }

    v8Ribs(m, -7.8, 11.8, 16.4, 33.6, 8.05, 'x', lod > 0 ? 6 : 4, .22, V8_STEEL);
    v8CableTray(m, -7.55, 17, -7.55, 33.5, 2.8, V8_STEEL, 5); v8CableTray(m, 11.55, 18.3, 11.55, 22.7, 2.8, V8_STEEL, 2);
    // screen wall on the power gallery (y 3) around the switch at (7.8, 4.4, 32.4): tiles 0 power, 11 round, 12 status, 13 wayfinding, 7 crate
    v8Screen(m, 5.3, 4.9, 33.67, 1.6, .95, [0, 0, -1], 12); v8Screen(m, 10.3, 4.9, 33.67, 1.6, .95, [0, 0, -1], 11); v8Screen(m, 3.0, 4.9, 33.67, 1.3, .95, [0, 0, -1], 13); v8Screen(m, 11.4, 5.95, 33.67, .9, .55, [0, 0, -1], 0);

    v8FlatStrip(m, -3.8, 28.3, 9.8, 28.3, 3.02, .12, V8_MAT.STRIP, V8_CYAN, 0);
    v8Screen(m, 1.3, 4.9, 33.67, 1.2, .8, [0, 0, -1], 7);

    m.cylinder([11.45, 0, 26], [11.45, .9, 26], .42, 3, V8_DARK, 10, .3); v8Quad(m, [11.05, .92, 25.6], [11.05, .92, 26.4], [11.85, .92, 26.4], [11.85, .92, 25.6], [0, 1, 0], V8_MAT.SCREEN, [1, 1, 1], v8Tile(10));
    v8Screen(m, 11.67, 2.1, 20.5, 1.4, .8, [-1, 0, 0], 10, true); v8Screen(m, -7.67, 2.1, 19, 1.4, .8, [1, 0, 0], 3);
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) v8FlatStrip(m, -7.6, 18 + i * 5.2, 11.6, 18 + i * 5.2, 8.02, .16, V8_MAT.STRIP, V8_WHITE, 0, -1);
  });
  zone('gantry', () => {
    // scaffold trusses on the wall lines, lattice masts at the launch-complex corners, umbilicals, fuel lines, pad vents flush with the north wall

function v8DrawArch(rend, vp, program) {
  if (!v8Arch || !v8ArchRanges) return;
  const planes = [];
  for (const [t, o] of [[0, 1], [0, -1], [1, 1], [1, -1], [2, 1], [2, -1]]) { const i = [vp[3] + o * vp[t], vp[7] + o * vp[4 + t], vp[11] + o * vp[8 + t], vp[15] + o * vp[12 + t]], n = Math.hypot(i[0], i[1], i[2]); planes.push(i.map(e => e / n)); }
  const vis = r => planes.every(t => t[0] * (t[0] > 0 ? r.hi[0] : r.lo[0]) + t[1] * (t[1] > 0 ? r.hi[1] : r.lo[1]) + t[2] * (t[2] > 0 ? r.hi[2] : r.lo[2]) + t[3] >= 0);
  let runs = []; for (const r of v8ArchRanges) { if (!vis(r)) continue; const last = runs[runs.length - 1]; if (last && last.start + last.count === r.start) last.count += r.count; else runs.push({ start: r.start, count: r.count }); }
  while (runs.length > 3) { let bi = 0, bg = 1e9; for (let i = 0; i + 1 < runs.length; i++) { const gap = runs[i + 1].start - (runs[i].start + runs[i].count); if (gap < bg) { bg = gap; bi = i; } } runs[bi].count = runs[bi + 1].start + runs[bi + 1].count - runs[bi].start; runs.splice(bi + 1, 1); }
  const I = identity(); for (const run of runs) rend.draw({ vao: v8Arch.vao, start: run.start, count: run.count }, I, program);
  if (program === rend.program) { v8Stats.archDraws = runs.length; v8Stats.archDrawnVerts = runs.reduce((a, r) => a + r.count, 0); }
}
// ---------- dynamic models (fans, cables, service arms, indicators, lander glow, coil) ----------
function v8BuildDynamics(rend) {
  if (v8Dyn || !rend || typeof Mesh === 'undefined') return;
  v8Dyn = {};
  const mk = (fn) => { const m = new Mesh(); fn(m); return rend.gpu(m); };
  v8Dyn.fan = mk(m => { m.cylinder([0, -.1, 0], [0, .1, 0], .22, 3, V8_DARK, 8); for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) m.box(0, 0, .55, .34, .03, .95, 3, V8_STEEL, [.5, i * Math.PI / 2, 0]); });
  v8Dyn.cable = mk(m => { m.cylinder([0, 0, 0], [0, -1.6, 0], .035, 3, V8_DARK, 5); m.box(0, -1.68, 0, .12, .16, .12, 3, V8_DARK); v8FlatStrip(m, -.05, 0, .05, 0, -1.77, .1, V8_MAT.STRIP, V8_RED, 2, -1); });
  v8Dyn.arm = mk(m => { m.box(0, 0, 2.6, .5, .4, 5.2, 3, V8_STEEL); m.box(0, .25, 4.9, .4, .3, .7, 3, V8_DARK); m.cylinder([0, -.3, 1], [0, -.3, 5], .07, 3, V8_COPPER, 6); v8FlatStrip(m, 0, 1, 0, 4.6, .22, .18, V8_MAT.STRIP, V8_AMBER, 0); });
  v8Dyn.ind = [V8_RED, V8_AMBER, V8_GREEN].map(c => mk(m => { m.box(0, 0, 0, .5, .14, .2, 3, V8_DARK); v8WallQuad(m, 0, 0, -.101, .42, .08, [0, 0, -1], V8_MAT.STRIP, c, [[0, 0], [0, 1], [0, 1], [0, 0]]); v8WallQuad(m, 0, 0, .101, .42, .08, [0, 0, 1], V8_MAT.STRIP, c, [[0, 0], [0, 1], [0, 1], [0, 0]]); }));
  v8Dyn.glow = mk(m => { for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) v8FlatStrip(m, -.45, -.3 + i * .3, .45, -.3 + i * .3, 0, .22, V8_MAT.STRIP, [.5, .8, 1], 2, -1); });
  v8Dyn.coil = mk(m => { for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { const z = -.05 - i * .035, r = .028 + i * .006; for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) { const a0 = k / 8 * Math.PI * 2, a1 = (k + 1) / 8 * Math.PI * 2; m.cylinder([Math.cos(a0) * r, Math.sin(a0) * r, z], [Math.cos(a1) * r, Math.sin(a1) * r, z], .0035, V8_MAT.STRIP, V8_CYAN, 4); } } });
}
function v8DrawDynamics(rend, program) {
  if (!v8Dyn) v8BuildDynamics(rend);
  if (!v8Dyn || !S) return;
  const t = S.time, lod = v8Lod(), o = S.defense; let draws = 0;
  const spin = t * (1.1 + .2 * lod);
  for (const [x, y, z, s] of [[-6, 7.86, -6, 1], [6, 7.86, 8, -1], [-23, 6.72, 3.5, 1], [2, 8.1, 25, -1]]) { rend.draw(v8Dyn.fan, model(x, y, z, 0, spin * s, 0), program); draws++; }
  if (lod > 0) for (const [x, y, z, ph] of [[-8.6, 7.7, -2, 0], [22, 3.6, 20.5, 1.7], [60, 3.9, 30, 3.1]]) { const sw = v8Motion() * .12 * Math.sin(t * 1.3 + ph); rend.draw(v8Dyn.cable, model(x, y, z, sw, 0, sw * .5), program); draws++; }
  const launch = o.rocketLaunched ? clamp((t - o.rocketAt) / 4, 0, 1) : 0, retract = v8Smooth(launch);
  for (const x of [51, 56, 61]) { rend.draw(v8Dyn.arm, model(x, 5.4 + retract * .6, 17.6 - retract * 2.6, -retract * .5, 0, 0), program); draws++; }
  v8Stats.dynDraws = draws;
}
// ---------- doors: servo motion + lintel indicator ----------
function v8DoorRise(u) { if (u < .16) return -.06 * Math.sin(u / .16 * Math.PI); return v8Smooth((u - .16) / .84); }
function v8DrawDoors(rend, o, a, program) {
  const t = S ? S.time : 0, trace = o.trace || 0;
  for (const d of WORLD.doors) {
    const rot = "x" === d.axis ? Math.PI / 2 : 0, open = !!o.doors[d.id];
    if (!open) rend.draw(a.phaseGate, mm(model(d.x, d.y, d.z, 0, rot, 0), ms(d.width / 4.65, 1, 1)), program);
    else { const at = v8DoorOpenAt[d.id]; if (at != null) { const u = (t - at) / (d.automatic ? 1.7 : .95); if (u < 1) rend.draw(a.phaseGate, mm(model(d.x, d.y + v8DoorRise(u) * 4.15, d.z, 0, rot, 0), ms(d.width / 4.65, 1, 1)), program); } }
    if (v8Dyn && d.id !== 'upperLink') { const st = open ? 2 : (d.automatic ? 0 : (trace >= d.cost ? 1 : 0)); rend.draw(v8Dyn.ind[st], model(d.x, d.y + 4.52, d.z, 0, rot, 0), program); }
  }
}
// ---------- screens (procedural canvas atlas, 4x4 tiles of 128px) ----------
function v8ScreenInit(rend) {

  v8DrawScreens(0); v8ScreenTex = rend.texture2D(v8ScreenCanvas);
}

  const bars = (x, y, n, w, h, seed) => { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const v = .25 + .75 * Math.abs(Math.sin(seed * 3.1 + i * 1.7 + t * (.6 + .3 * (i % 3)))); c.fillStyle = i % 4 === 3 ? '#ffb347' : '#35d6ff'; c.fillRect(x + i * (w + 3), y + h * (1 - v), w, h * v); } };
  const blink = Math.floor(t * 2) % 2 === 0, cyan = '#35d6ff', amber = '#ffb347', red = '#ff4a3a';
  tile(0, () => { txt('MAIN POWER', 10, 26, 15, cyan); txt(on ? 'ONLINE' : 'OFFLINE', 64, 76, 26, on ? '#6cff9a' : (blink ? red : '#5a1a14'), 'center'); txt(on ? ('GRID ' + Math.round(wake * 100) + '%') : 'ROUTE TO CONTROL', 64, 108, 12, on ? cyan : amber, 'center'); });

function v8ScreenTick(rend) {
  if (!v8ScreenTex) v8ScreenInit(rend);
  const rate = v8Lod() === 0 ? 1 : v8Lod() === 2 ? 4 : 2, now = performance.now() / 1000; // each tile refreshes at 1/2/4 Hz; one tile per frame at most
  if (now - v8ScreenAt < 1 / (16 * rate)) return;
  v8ScreenAt = now; const i = v8ScreenNext++ % 16; v8DrawScreens(S ? S.time : now, i);
  const gl = rend.gl; gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE11); gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, v8ScreenTex); gl.texSubImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, (i % 4) * 128, Math.floor(i / 4) * 128, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, v8TileCanvas);
}
// ---------- particles (own program, additive points, CPU simulated) ----------
const V8_PART_VS = "#version 300 es\nprecision highp float;layout(location=0) in vec4 aP;layout(location=1) in vec4 aQ;uniform mat4 uVP;uniform vec3 uEye;out float alpha;out vec3 tint;out float kind;void main(){kind=aQ.x;float life=aP.w;float fade=smoothstep(0.,.12,life)*smoothstep(0.,.35,1.-life);float d=max(length(aP.xyz-uEye),.5);alpha=fade*(kind<.5?.18:kind<1.5?.9:kind<2.5?.6:.5);tint=kind<.5?vec3(.55,.62,.7):kind<1.5?vec3(1.,.55,.18):kind<2.5?vec3(.55,.8,1.):vec3(1.,.42,.12);gl_PointSize=clamp(aQ.y*(kind<.5?1.+life*1.6:1.)*38./d,1.,(kind<.5?34.:9.));gl_Position=uVP*vec4(aP.xyz,1.);}";
const V8_PART_FS = "#version 300 es\nprecision highp float;in float alpha;in vec3 tint;in float kind;out vec4 outColor;void main(){float r=length(gl_PointCoord-.5);if(r>.5)discard;float s=kind<.5?exp(-r*r*7.):exp(-r*r*16.);outColor=vec4(tint*alpha*s,alpha*s);}";
function v8PartInit(rend) {
  if (v8PartProgram) return;
  const gl = rend.gl, n = v8Lod() === 0 ? 96 : v8Lod() === 2 ? 512 : 256;
  v8PartProgram = rend.programOf(V8_PART_VS, V8_PART_FS);
  v8Part = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) v8Part.push({ x: 0, y: -50, z: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, vz: 0, life: 0, max: 1, kind: 0, size: 1 });
  v8PartData = new Float32Array(n * 8);
  v8PartVAO = gl.createVertexArray(); gl.bindVertexArray(v8PartVAO); v8PartBuf = gl.createBuffer(); gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, v8PartBuf); gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, v8PartData, gl.DYNAMIC_DRAW);
  gl.enableVertexAttribArray(0); gl.vertexAttribPointer(0, 4, gl.FLOAT, false, 32, 0); gl.enableVertexAttribArray(1); gl.vertexAttribPointer(1, 4, gl.FLOAT, false, 32, 16); gl.bindVertexArray(null);
  v8Stats.particles = n;
}
function v8Emit(kind, x, y, z, vx, vy, vz, life, size, spread) {
  if (!v8Part) return; const R = v8AnimRng;
  for (const p of v8Part) if (p.life <= 0) { p.kind = kind; p.x = x + (R() - .5) * spread; p.y = y + (R() - .5) * spread * .4; p.z = z + (R() - .5) * spread; p.vx = vx + (R() - .5) * .6; p.vy = vy + (R() - .5) * .3; p.vz = vz + (R() - .5) * .6; p.max = life * (.7 + .6 * R()); p.life = p.max; p.size = size * (.7 + .6 * R()); return; }
}
function v8PartTick(s, dt) {
  if (!v8Part) return; const t = s.time, o = s.defense, R = v8AnimRng, lod = v8Lod(), budget = lod === 0 ? .5 : lod === 2 ? 1.6 : 1;
  // steam: bunker tank top, gantry vents (after launch), launch footing (first 12 s after launch)
  if (R() < .5 * budget) v8Emit(0, -30.5, 6.7, 7, 0, 1.2, 0, 2.4, 1.3, .3);
  if (R() < .22 * budget) v8Emit(0, -31.5, 2.35, 3 + R() * 8, .9, .25, 0, 1.6, 1.0, .2);
  if (o.rocketLaunched && t - o.rocketAt < 14) { for (const x of [48.5, 52.5, 59.5, 63.5]) if (R() < .9) v8Emit(0, x, .8, 16.9, 0, 2.6, -1.2, 1.8, 1.8, .5); if (R() < .9) v8Emit(0, 56 + (R() - .5) * 8, .4, 28 + (R() - .5) * 8, (R() - .5) * 3, 3.5, (R() - .5) * 3, 2.6, 2.4, 1); }
  // sparks: intermittent bursts from two cable spots (and the control room tray)
  for (const sp of v8Spark) { if (t > sp.next) { sp.next = t + 2.2 + R() * 4; sp.until = t + .25 + R() * .3; } if (t < sp.until && R() < .8 * budget) v8Emit(1, sp.x, sp.y, sp.z, (R() - .5) * 2.4, -1 - R() * 2, (R() - .5) * 2.4, .5, .55, .1); }
  // lander thruster
  if (o.travel) { const p = s.p; for (let i = 0; i < 2 * budget; i++) v8Emit(2, p.x, p.y - .35, p.z, (R() - .5) * 1.5, -4 - R() * 3, (R() - .5) * 1.5, .5, 1.1, .5); }
  // embers over the power gallery once the grid is awake
  if (o.power && R() < .18 * budget) v8Emit(3, 7.8 + (R() - .5) * 3, 4.3, 32.2 + (R() - .5) * 1.5, 0, .4, 0, 2.2, .45, 1);
  for (const p of v8Part) { if (p.life <= 0) continue; p.life -= dt; p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.z += p.vz * dt; if (p.kind === 1) p.vy -= 9 * dt; else if (p.kind === 0) { p.vy += .35 * dt; p.vx *= .98; p.vz *= .98; } else if (p.kind === 3) p.vy += .1 * dt; }
}
function v8DrawParticles(rend) {
  if (!v8Part || !S || !rend.lastVP) return; const gl = rend.gl; let n = 0;
  for (const p of v8Part) { if (p.life <= 0) continue; const k = n * 8; v8PartData[k] = p.x; v8PartData[k + 1] = p.y; v8PartData[k + 2] = p.z; v8PartData[k + 3] = clamp(p.life / p.max, 0, 1); v8PartData[k + 4] = p.kind; v8PartData[k + 5] = p.size; v8PartData[k + 6] = 0; v8PartData[k + 7] = 0; n++; }
  if (!n) return;
  gl.useProgram(v8PartProgram); rend.m(v8PartProgram, "uVP", rend.lastVP || identity()); rend.v(v8PartProgram, "uEye", rend.lastEye || [0, 0, 0]);
  gl.bindVertexArray(v8PartVAO); gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, v8PartBuf); gl.bufferSubData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, 0, v8PartData, 0, n * 8);
  gl.blendFunc(gl.SRC_ALPHA, gl.ONE); gl.drawArrays(gl.POINTS, 0, n); gl.blendFunc(gl.SRC_ALPHA, gl.ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA); gl.bindVertexArray(null);
}

function v8Telegraph(t) { const c = t % 32; if (c >= 21 && c <= 27) return 2; if (c >= 18.5 && c < 21) return (c - 18.5) / 2.5; return 0; }

// ---------- viewmodel motion layer ----------
function v8ViewMatrix(e, t) {
  const p = e.p, mo = v8Motion(), now = e.time; let yaw = 0, pitch = 0, roll = 0, x = 0, y = 0, z = 0;
  // sway: low-passed look delta (tau .04 s) -> ±1.5°
  yaw += clamp(v8Look.sx * .0009, -.026, .026) * mo; pitch += clamp(v8Look.sy * .0009, -.026, .026) * mo;
  // inertia from velocity change in the camera frame (tau .12 s)
  x += -v8Vm.ix * .0028 * mo; z += v8Vm.iz * .0022 * mo; y += -p.vy * .004 * mo;
  // breathing 0.3 Hz, 0.02 m / 0.5° at full motion
  y += Math.sin(now * 1.885) * .02 * mo * (1 - .7 * p.aim); pitch += Math.sin(now * 1.885 + .6) * .0087 * mo * (1 - .7 * p.aim);
  // sprint pose: drop 25°, 8 Hz sway, blended over .15 s
  const sp = v8Vm.sprint; pitch += -.436 * sp; y += -.05 * sp; x += .03 * sp + Math.sin(now * 50.3) * .004 * sp * mo; roll += Math.sin(now * 50.3 + 1) * .02 * sp * mo;
  // draw / holster on slot change (.35 s ease-out cubic)
  const du = clamp((now - v8Vm.drawAt) / .35, 0, 1), dw = 1 - v8Ease(du); y += -.2 * dw; z += .05 * dw; pitch += -.6 * dw;
  // fire recoil overlay: kick*exp(-t/.04)*cos(40t) over .26 s
  const rt = now - v8Vm.shotAt; if (rt >= 0 && rt < .26) { const spec = weaponSpec(p.weapon), k = spec.mode === 'scatter' ? .07 : spec.mode === 'automatic' ? .022 : spec.mode === 'charge' ? .05 : .045; const r = k * Math.exp(-rt / .04) * Math.cos(40 * rt); pitch += r; z += r * .6; }
  // reload stage snap (bolt at 85 %) for magazine weapons
  if (p.reload > 0) { const L = gunStats(e).reloadSeconds, h = clamp(1 - p.reload / L, 0, 1); if (h > .85 && h < .93 && p.weapon !== 'bellwether' && p.weapon !== 'gbe') { const q = Math.sin((h - .85) / .08 * Math.PI); z += .012 * q; roll += .035 * q; } }
  return mm(mt(x, y, z), mm(ry(yaw), mm(rx(pitch), rz(roll))));
}
function v8DrawViewmodel(orig, e, t) {
  const M = v8ViewMatrix(e, t), rd = this.draw, gunModels = [this.models.gunCantor, this.models.gunMorrow, this.models.gunBellwether, this.models.gunVesper, this.models.graviticEmitter];
  v8Vm.gunMat = null;
  this.draw = (m, mat, prog) => { const mm2 = mm(M, mat); if (gunModels.indexOf(m) >= 0) v8Vm.gunMat = mm2; return rd.call(this, m, mm2, prog); };
  try { orig.call(this, e, t); } finally { this.draw = rd; }
  if (e.p.weapon === 'gbe' && v8Dyn && v8Vm.gunMat) { const lvl = CHARGE.held ? clamp((CHARGE.time || 0) / 1.65, 0, 1) : 0; const spin = t * (2 + 26 * lvl); this.draw(v8Dyn.coil, mm(v8Vm.gunMat, mm(mt(0, .03, -.19), mm(rz(spin), ms(1 + lvl * .8, 1 + lvl * .8, 1)))), this.program); }
}

// ---------- audio cues (through FieldAudio's own tone/burst primitives, respecting volume + active) ----------
function v8CuePowerWave() { if (!audio) return; const bands = 6; for (let k = 0; k < bands; k++) { const at = k * (V8_WAKE_SECONDS / bands); audio.tone(66 + 17 * k, 1.2, .045, null, at); audio.tone(132 + 34 * k, .9, .028, null, at + .06); audio.burst(.55, .06, 700 + 260 * k, "bandpass", null, at + .02); } audio.tone(36, 1.6, .09, null, 0); audio.tone(261.6, 1.4, .05, null, V8_WAKE_SECONDS - .1); audio.tone(392, 1.6, .04, null, V8_WAKE_SECONDS); }
function v8CueDoor(pos, heavy) { if (!audio) return; audio.burst(heavy ? 1.5 : .9, .11, 220, "lowpass", pos, 0, 1.1); audio.tone(heavy ? 42 : 55, heavy ? 1.5 : .9, .11, pos, 0, 20); audio.burst(.12, .18, 420, "bandpass", pos, heavy ? 1.45 : .82); audio.tone(heavy ? 70 : 92, .28, .1, pos, heavy ? 1.45 : .82, 40); }
function v8CueMachine(pos, ok) { if (!audio) return; if (ok) { audio.tone(880, .09, .045, pos); audio.tone(1318, .14, .04, pos, .1); } else { audio.tone(164, .24, .07, pos, 0, 36); audio.burst(.2, .06, 320, "lowpass", pos); } }
function v8CueRound() { if (!audio) return; audio.tone(329.6, .4, .04, null, 0); audio.tone(440, .6, .035, null, .18); audio.burst(.5, .04, 1600, "bandpass", null, .05); }
function v8CueLaunchArms(pos) { if (!audio) return; audio.burst(3.6, .1, 160, "lowpass", pos, 0, 1.25); audio.tone(46, 3.4, .09, pos, 0, 12); audio.burst(.3, .14, 260, "bandpass", pos, 3.5); }
// ---------- tick wrapper: state tracking, light wake, particles, viewmodel smoothing ----------
function v8Tick(original, s, dt, controls) {
  const r = original(s, dt, controls);
  v8Guard('tick', () => {
    if (v8LastS !== s) { v8LastS = s; v8DoorOpenAt = {}; v8LastWave = s.defense.wave; v8LastPower = s.defense.power; v8LastRocket = s.defense.rocketLaunched; v8LastTravel = null; v8Flash.t = -10; v8Vm.weapon = s.p.weapon; v8Vm.drawAt = -10; v8Vm.shotCd = 0; v8Vm.shotAt = -10; v8Spark = [{ x: -8.6, y: 7.5, z: -2, next: 2, until: 0 }, { x: 22, y: 3.3, z: 20.5, next: 4, until: 0 }, { x: -7.6, y: 2.75, z: 24, next: 6, until: 0 }]; for (const p of (v8Part || [])) p.life = 0; }
    const o = s.defense, p = s.p, t = s.time;
    for (const d of WORLD.doors) if (o.doors[d.id] && v8DoorOpenAt[d.id] == null) { v8DoorOpenAt[d.id] = t; if (t > .5) v8CueDoor([d.x, d.y + 2, d.z], !!d.automatic); }
    if (o.wave !== v8LastWave) { v8LastWave = o.wave; v8RoundTitle(o.monkeyRound ? 'SPACE MONKEYS' : 'ROUND ' + o.wave, o.monkeyRound ? 'DEFEND THE PERK MACHINES' : 'COSMODROME · ' + (o.power ? 'GRID ONLINE' : 'GRID OFFLINE')); v8CueRound(); }
    if (o.power && !v8LastPower) { v8LastPower = true; v8CuePowerWave(); v8RoundTitle('POWER RESTORED', 'FACILITY WAKING UP'); }
    if (o.rocketLaunched && !v8LastRocket) { v8LastRocket = true; v8CueLaunchArms([56, 5, 17.6]); }
    if (!v8LightDist) v8LightDist = WORLD.lights.map(l => Math.hypot(l.p[0] - V8_SWITCH[0], l.p[2] - V8_SWITCH[2]));
    if (o.power) { const wake = v8WakeValue(s); for (let i = 0; i < WORLD.lights.length; i++) { const w = v8Smooth((wake * V8_WAKE_RADIUS - v8LightDist[i]) / 10); WORLD.lights[i].power *= mix(.64, 1, w); } }
    v8PartTick(s, dt);
    // viewmodel smoothing state
    const k1 = 1 - Math.exp(-dt / .04), k2 = 1 - Math.exp(-dt / .12);
    v8Look.sx += (v8Look.dx - v8Look.sx) * k1; v8Look.sy += (v8Look.dy - v8Look.sy) * k1; v8Look.dx *= Math.exp(-dt / .05); v8Look.dy *= Math.exp(-dt / .05);
    const c = Math.cos(p.yaw), sn = Math.sin(p.yaw), lat = -p.vx * c + p.vz * sn, fw = p.vx * sn + p.vz * c; // camera right = (-cos yaw, 0, sin yaw)
    v8Vm.ix += ((lat - v8Vm.pvx) / Math.max(dt, 1e-3) * .02 - v8Vm.ix) * k2; v8Vm.iz += ((fw - v8Vm.pvz) / Math.max(dt, 1e-3) * .02 - v8Vm.iz) * k2; v8Vm.pvx = lat; v8Vm.pvz = fw;
    const sprinting = input.sprint && (Math.abs(p.vx) + Math.abs(p.vz) > 3.4) && p.stamina > 1 && !p.aim && !p.reload ? 1 : 0; v8Vm.sprint += (sprinting - v8Vm.sprint) * (1 - Math.exp(-dt / .15));
    if (p.weapon !== v8Vm.weapon) { v8Vm.weapon = p.weapon; v8Vm.drawAt = t; }
    if (p.shotCd > v8Vm.shotCd + 1e-4) v8Vm.shotAt = t; v8Vm.shotCd = p.shotCd;
  });
  return r;
}
function v8Interact(original, e) {
  const r = original(e);
  v8Guard('interact', () => { if (!r) return; const it = typeof interactable === 'function' ? interactable(e) : null; const m = it && WORLD.machines.find(x => x.id === it.id); if (r.ok && (r.perk || r.weapon != null || r.power || r.launch || r.tier != null || r.pad)) { v8ActionPulse('v8-ok'); if (m) { v8Flash = { pos: [m.x, (m.baseY || 0) + 1.3, m.z], t: e.time, kind: 1 }; v8CueMachine([m.x, m.y || 1, m.z], true); } } else if (!r.ok && r.error && m && it.kind !== 'repair') { v8ActionPulse('v8-deny'); v8Flash = { pos: [m.x, (m.baseY || 0) + 1.3, m.z], t: e.time, kind: 2 }; v8CueMachine([m.x, m.y || 1, m.z], false); } else if (!r.ok && r.error && it && it.kind === 'door') { v8ActionPulse('v8-deny'); } });
  return r;
}
function installV8Hooks() {
  tick = v8Tick.bind(null, tick);
  interact = v8Interact.bind(null, interact);
  applyLook = ((o) => function (dx, dy) { v8Look.dx += dx; v8Look.dy += dy; return o(dx, dy); })(applyLook);
  const v8Static = Renderer.prototype.drawStatic;
  Renderer.prototype.drawStatic = function (vp, program) { v8Static.call(this, vp, program); const main = program === this.program; if (v8Arch && (main || (this.v8Pass === 'key' && v8Lod() >= 1))) v8Guard('archDraw', () => v8DrawArch(this, vp, program)); if (main) v8Guard('dynDraw', () => v8DrawDynamics(this, program)); };
  const v8Shadow = Renderer.prototype.shadowPass; // architecture casts into the key (sun) map at Balanced/High only; never into the per-frame flashlight fill map
  Renderer.prototype.shadowPass = function (e, t, a) { this.v8Pass = e === this.keyShadow ? 'key' : 'fill'; try { return v8Shadow.call(this, e, t, a); } finally { this.v8Pass = null; } };
  const v8Render = Renderer.prototype.render;
  Renderer.prototype.render = function (e) { // skip the V8 pre-render work while the previous frame's GPU fence is still pending (render() early-outs in that case)
    if (!(this.frameFence && this.gl.clientWaitSync(this.frameFence, 0, 0) === this.gl.TIMEOUT_EXPIRED)) v8Guard('beforeRender', () => v8BeforeRender(this, e));
    return v8Render.call(this, e); };
  const v8M = Renderer.prototype.m; Renderer.prototype.m = function (p, n, val) { if (n === "uVP" && p === this.dustProgram) this.lastVP = val; return v8M.call(this, p, n, val); };
  const v8Vf = Renderer.prototype.v; Renderer.prototype.v = function (p, n, val) { if (n === "uEye" && p === this.dustProgram) this.lastEye = val; return v8Vf.call(this, p, n, val); };
  const v8Vmo = Renderer.prototype.drawViewmodel;
  Renderer.prototype.drawViewmodel = function (e, t) { return v8DrawViewmodel.call(this, v8Vmo, e, t); };
  v8Guard('hud', v8HudInit);
}

let v9Stats = { dynDraws: 0, dynVerts: 0, vmDraws: 0, shots: 0, hits: 0, exports: 0, ghosts: 0, cues: 0, resMode: 0, w: 0, h: 0, cells: 0, sent: 0, jams: 0, enemyFx: 0 };
function v9Guard(name, fn) { // fused call guard: a site that fails 3 times is switched off instead of spamming
  const s = v9Sites[name] || (v9Sites[name] = { fails: 0, off: false });
  if (s.off) return null;
  try { return fn(); } catch (err) { s.fails++; if (s.fails === 1) v9Errors.push(name + ': ' + (err && err.message || err)); if (s.fails >= 3) { s.off = true; v9Errors.push(name + ': disabled after 3 failures'); } return null; }
}

// ---------- seed of the day (C4) ----------
function v9DaySeed() { const d = new Date(); return d.getFullYear() * 10000 + (d.getMonth() + 1) * 100 + d.getDate(); }
function v9SeedFor(base) {
  const mode = Math.round(v9Num('v9seed'));
  if (mode === 2) { try { const q = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('seed'); if (q != null && q !== '' && Number.isFinite(+q)) return Math.abs(Math.floor(+q)) >>> 0; } catch (e) {} return v9DaySeed(); }
  if (mode === 1) return v9DaySeed();
  return base;
}

function v9Card(s) {
  const d = s.defense, acc = v9 && v9.shots ? Math.round(100 * v9.hits / v9.shots) : 0, hs = d.kills ? Math.round(100 * d.headshots / d.kills) : 0;
  const sig = v9 && v9.sentAt >= 0 ? 'SIGNAL SENT' : v9 && v9.lockAt >= 0 ? 'LOCK INTERRUPTED' : 'CELLS ' + (v9 ? v9.found : 0) + '/3';
  return 'LAST SIGNAL · R' + d.wave + ' · ' + d.kills + ' KILLS · ' + hs + ' % HS · ' + acc + ' % ACC · ' + Math.round(d.trace) + ' PTS · ' + Math.floor(s.time) + ' s · ' + sig + ' · SEED ' + (s.seed || 0) + ' · ' + V9_BUILD;
}
function v9RunCard() { const el = document.getElementById('death-stats'); if (!el || !S) return; el.textContent = v9Card(S); }
function v9CopyCard() {
  const text = v9Card(S), b = document.getElementById('v9-copy');
  const show = (msg) => { if (b) { b.textContent = msg; setTimeout(() => { b.textContent = 'COPY RUN CARD'; }, 1400); } };
  const legacy = () => { let ok = false; try { const ta = document.createElement('textarea'); ta.value = text; ta.setAttribute('readonly', ''); ta.style.position = 'fixed'; ta.style.opacity = '0'; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select(); ok = document.execCommand('copy'); ta.remove(); } catch (e) { ok = false; } show(ok ? 'COPIED' : 'COPY BLOCKED · SEE CARD'); };
  if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => show('COPIED'), legacy); // async API rejects without permission → legacy path, never an unhandled rejection
  else legacy();
}

// ---------- audio: radio chirps, morse compass, mechanical shot/door layers (existing FieldAudio primitives only) ----------
function v9Chirp(gain = 1) { if (!audio || !audio.ctx || !audio.active) return; audio.tone(1180, .05, .028 * gain, null, 0, 0, .8); audio.tone(1480, .06, .024 * gain, null, .07, 0, .8); audio.burst(.14, .018 * gain, 3200, 'highpass', null, .02, .6); v9Stats.cues++; }
function v9Morse(pos, gain, pattern, freq = 1046) { // pattern: '.' dot (.06 s) '-' dash (.17 s)
  if (!audio || !audio.ctx || !audio.active) return 0; let at = 0; const R = v9AudioRng;
  for (const c of pattern) { if (c === ' ') { at += .2; continue; } const d = c === '-' ? .17 : .06; audio.tone(freq + (R() - .5) * 30, d, gain, pos, at, 0, .9); at += d + .08; }
  v9Stats.cues++; return at;
}
function v9ShotLayer(a, w, pos, tier) {
  if (!a.ctx || !a.active || !v9On('v9audio')) return;
  const R = v9AudioRng, longR = a.room === 'long', spec = weaponSpec(w) || {}, mode = spec.mode;
  a.burst(.07, .05 * (longR ? 1.4 : 1), 820, 'lowpass', pos, .038 + R() * .012, 1.4);                 // first reflection
  a.burst(.11, .032 * (longR ? 1.5 : 1), 520, 'lowpass', pos, .079 + R() * .02, 1.6);                // second reflection
  if (longR) a.burst(.26, .028, 400, 'lowpass', pos, .16 + R() * .03, 1.8);                           // hall tail
  if (mode !== 'scatter' && w !== 'gbe') { a.burst(.018, .035, 5200, 'highpass', pos, .055, .5); a.tone(5600 + R() * 900, .025, .016, pos, .21 + R() * .05, 2400, .4); a.tone(4900 + R() * 900, .02, .012, pos, .3 + R() * .06, 1800, .4); } // bolt tick + casing tinks
  if (mode === 'scatter') { a.burst(.05, .06, 1500, 'bandpass', pos, .12, .7); a.tone(48, .1, .07, pos, 0, 22, 1.1); }   // pump rack + body
  if (w === 'vesper') a.tone(52, .09, .06, pos, 0, 24, 1.05);
  v9Stats.cues++;
}
function v9DoorLayer(a, pos) { if (!a.ctx || !a.active || !v9On('v9audio')) return; a.burst(.42, .05, 3400, 'highpass', pos, .36, .7); a.tone(1500, .04, .02, pos, .78, 600, .5); a.tone(31, .5, .1, pos, .05, 10, 1.3); v9Stats.cues++; }
// ---------- V9 bodies (non-colliding): signal cells, transmitter, holo sight, heat rings ----------
function v9BuildDynamics(rend) {
  if (v9Dyn || !rend || typeof Mesh === 'undefined') return;
  v9Dyn = {}; let verts = 0;
  const mk = (fn) => { const m = new Mesh(); fn(m); verts += m.v.length / 12; return rend.gpu(m); };
  const CYAN = [.25, .85, 1], AMBER = [1, .62, .18], DARK = [.22, .24, .27], STEEL = [.55, .58, .62];
  v9Dyn.cell = mk(m => { m.cylinder([0, -.26, 0], [0, .26, 0], .11, 3, DARK, 10); m.cylinder([0, -.3, 0], [0, -.26, 0], .13, 3, STEEL, 10); m.cylinder([0, .26, 0], [0, .3, 0], .13, 3, STEEL, 10);
    for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) { const a0 = k / 4 * Math.PI * 2; v8VStrip(m, Math.cos(a0) * .112, -.18, .18, Math.sin(a0) * .112, [Math.cos(a0), 0, Math.sin(a0)], CYAN, 2); } });
  v9Dyn.tx = mk(m => { m.box(0, .5, 0, 1.3, 1, .7, 3, DARK); m.box(0, 1.02, 0, 1.2, .06, .62, 3, STEEL); m.cylinder([0, 1.05, 0], [0, 3.6, 0], .05, 3, STEEL, 6);
    for (let k = 0; k < 12; k++) { const a0 = k / 12 * Math.PI * 2, a1 = (k + 1) / 12 * Math.PI * 2; m.cylinder([Math.cos(a0) * .55, 3.3 + .25 * Math.cos(a0), Math.sin(a0) * .55], [Math.cos(a1) * .55, 3.3 + .25 * Math.cos(a1), Math.sin(a1) * .55], .018, 3, STEEL, 4); }
    v8FlatStrip(m, -.5, -.36, .5, -.36, 1.04, .08, V8_MAT.STRIP, CYAN, 2, 1); v8FlatStrip(m, -.5, .36, .5, .36, 1.04, .08, V8_MAT.STRIP, AMBER, 0, 1); });
  v9Dyn.beacon = mk(m => { v8VStrip(m, 0, 0, 2.2, 0, [1, 0, 0], CYAN, 2); v8VStrip(m, 0, 0, 2.2, 0, [-1, 0, 0], CYAN, 2); v8VStrip(m, 0, 0, 2.2, 0, [0, 0, 1], CYAN, 2); v8VStrip(m, 0, 0, 2.2, 0, [0, 0, -1], CYAN, 2); });
  v9Dyn.holo = mk(m => { const r = .011, n = 24; for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) { const a0 = k / n * Math.PI * 2, a1 = (k + 1) / n * Math.PI * 2; m.cylinder([Math.cos(a0) * r, Math.sin(a0) * r, 0], [Math.cos(a1) * r, Math.sin(a1) * r, 0], .0011, V8_MAT.STRIP, CYAN, 4); } for (const a of [0, Math.PI / 2, Math.PI, Math.PI * 1.5]) m.cylinder([Math.cos(a) * r * .55, Math.sin(a) * r * .55, 0], [Math.cos(a) * r * .9, Math.sin(a) * r * .9, 0], .0008, V8_MAT.STRIP, CYAN, 4); m.box(0, 0, 0, .0022, .0022, .0008, V8_MAT.STRIP, AMBER); }); // base radius .011; scaled by sight[3]
  v9Dyn.heat = mk(m => { const r = .02, n = 12; for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) { const a0 = k / n * Math.PI * 2, a1 = (k + 1) / n * Math.PI * 2; m.cylinder([Math.cos(a0) * r, Math.sin(a0) * r, 0], [Math.cos(a1) * r, Math.sin(a1) * r, 0], .0024, V8_MAT.STRIP, AMBER, 4); } }); // base radius .02; scaled per weapon (ring.r / .02)
  v9Stats.dynVerts = Math.round(verts);
}
function v9CellY(c) { if (c.y == null) { const f = floorAt(c.x, c.z, 0); c.y = (f ? f.y : 0); } return c.y; }
function v9DrawDynamics(rend, program) {
  if (!v9Dyn) v9BuildDynamics(rend);
  if (!v9Dyn || !S || !v9 || v9.s !== S) return;
  const t = S.time; let draws = 0;
  V9_CELLS.forEach((c, i) => { if (v9.cells[i]) return; const y = v9CellY(c) + .62 + .05 * Math.sin(t * 1.7 + i); rend.draw(v9Dyn.cell, model(c.x, y, c.z, 0, t * .8 + i, 0), program); draws++; });
  const ty = v9CellY(V9_TX);
  rend.draw(v9Dyn.tx, model(V9_TX.x, ty, V9_TX.z, 0, Math.PI * .25, 0), program); draws++;
  if (v9.lockAt >= 0) { const u = v9.sentAt >= 0 ? 1 : clamp((t - v9.lockAt) / V9_LOCK_SECONDS, 0, 1); rend.draw(v9Dyn.beacon, mm(model(V9_TX.x, ty + 3.6, V9_TX.z, 0, t * 1.5, 0), ms(1, 1 + 6 * u, 1)), program); draws++; }
  v9Stats.dynDraws = draws;
}
function v9DrawViewmodelExtras(rend, e, t) {
  if (!v9On('v9ballistics') || !v9 || !e || !e.p || typeof v8Vm === 'undefined' || !v8Vm.gunMat) return;
  if (!v9Dyn) v9BuildDynamics(rend); if (!v9Dyn) return;
  const w = e.p.weapon, spec = V9_HEAT[w]; let draws = 0;
  const heat = clamp(v9.heat[w] || 0, 0, 1), rings = Math.min(3, Math.floor(heat * 3.6));
  const rg = spec && spec.ring; if (rg) for (let i = 0; i < rings; i++) { const sc = rg.r / .02 * (1 + heat * .12); rend.draw(v9Dyn.heat, mm(v8Vm.gunMat, mm(mt(0, rg.y, rg.z[i]), ms(sc, sc, 1))), rend.program); draws++; }
  if (spec && spec.sight && e.p.aim > .6 && !v9.photo) { const sc = (spec.sight[3] || 1) * (1 + .05 * Math.sin(t * 9)); rend.draw(v9Dyn.holo, mm(v8Vm.gunMat, mm(mt(spec.sight[0], spec.sight[1], spec.sight[2]), ms(sc, sc, 1))), rend.program); draws++; }
  v9Stats.vmDraws = draws;

// ---------- camera punch (render-only: added before the base render, removed after; aim state is never changed) ----------
function v9CameraKick(now) {
  if (!v9 || v9.kickAmp <= 0) return null; const dt = now - v9.kickAt; if (dt < 0 || dt > .25) return null;
  const k = v9.kickAmp * v9.kickSign * Math.exp(-dt / .07) * Math.cos(28 * dt) * v8Motion(); return [k, k * .3];
}
// ---------- quest: THE LAST SIGNAL (C1) ----------
function v9NearCell(s) { const p = s.p; for (let i = 0; i < V9_CELLS.length; i++) { if (v9.cells[i]) continue; const c = V9_CELLS[i]; if (Math.hypot(c.x - p.x, c.z - p.z) < 1.9 && Math.abs(v9CellY(c) - p.y) < 1.6) return i; } return -1; }
function v9NearTx(s) { const p = s.p; return Math.hypot(V9_TX.x - p.x, V9_TX.z - p.z) < 2.3 && Math.abs(v9CellY(V9_TX) - p.y) < 1.6; }
function v9QuestInteract(e) {
  if (!v9 || v9.s !== e || e.phase !== 'alive') return null;
  if (typeof interactable === 'function' && interactable(e)) return null; // a base door/machine/rack/lander is targeted: never hijack it
  const ci = v9NearCell(e);
  if (ci >= 0) { v9.cells[ci] = true; v9.found++; v9Stats.cells = v9.found; v9Chirp(1.2); say(e, 'SIGNAL CELL ' + v9.found + '/3 RECOVERED · ' + V9_CELLS[ci].name, 4); if (v9.found === 3) say(e, 'OVERSEER · TRANSMITTER IN THE LAUNCH COMPLEX', 4); return { ok: true, v9cell: ci }; }
  if (v9NearTx(e)) {
    if (v9.found < 3) { say(e, 'TRANSMITTER DARK · ' + v9.found + '/3 SIGNAL CELLS', 2.5); return { ok: false, error: 'TRANSMITTER DARK · ' + v9.found + '/3 SIGNAL CELLS' }; }
    if (v9.lockAt < 0) { v9.lockAt = e.time; v9.lastLockSay = V9_LOCK_SECONDS; v9Chirp(1.5); say(e, 'OVERSEER · SIGNAL LOCKED — HOLD ' + V9_LOCK_SECONDS + ' SECONDS', 5); if (typeof v8RoundTitle === 'function') v8RoundTitle('SIGNAL LOCKED', 'HOLD THE TRANSMITTER · ' + V9_LOCK_SECONDS + ' S'); return { ok: true, v9lock: true }; }
  }
  return null;
}
function v9QuestTick(s, dt) {
  const t = s.time, p = s.p;
  // prompt (only when no base interactable is targeted)
  let prompt = '';
  const ci = v9NearCell(s);
  if (ci >= 0) prompt = '[E] RECOVER SIGNAL CELL · ' + (v9.found + 1) + '/3';
  else if (v9NearTx(s) && v9.lockAt < 0) prompt = v9.found < 3 ? 'TRANSMITTER · ' + v9.found + '/3 CELLS' : '[E] INSERT SIGNAL CELLS · START TRANSMISSION';
  if (prompt && typeof interactable === 'function' && interactable(s)) prompt = '';
  v9HudSet('v9-prompt', prompt);
  // morse compass: nearest missing cell, cadence quickens with proximity; after lock: SOS from the transmitter
  if (t >= v9.nextMorse) {
    if (v9.lockAt >= 0 && v9.sentAt < 0) { v9Morse([V9_TX.x, v9CellY(V9_TX) + 2.5, V9_TX.z], .04, '... --- ...', 880); v9.nextMorse = t + 3.2; }
    else if (v9.found < 3) { let best = -1, bd = 1e9; V9_CELLS.forEach((c, i) => { if (v9.cells[i]) return; const d = Math.hypot(c.x - p.x, c.z - p.z); if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = i; } });
      if (best >= 0) { const c = V9_CELLS[best], u = clamp((bd - 4) / 40, 0, 1); v9Morse([c.x, v9CellY(c) + 1, c.z], .012 + .03 * (1 - u), '...', 1046); v9.nextMorse = t + 1.4 + 5 * u + (v9AudioRng() - .5) * .4; } else v9.nextMorse = t + 5; }
    else v9.nextMorse = t + 5;
  }
  // signal lock countdown → TRANSMISSION SENT
  if (v9.lockAt >= 0 && v9.sentAt < 0) {
    const left = Math.max(0, V9_LOCK_SECONDS - (t - v9.lockAt)), pct = Math.round(100 * (1 - left / V9_LOCK_SECONDS));
    v9HudSet('v9-signal', 'SIGNAL LOCK · ' + Math.ceil(left) + ' S · ' + pct + ' %<i style="width:' + Math.max(4, pct * 1.8) + 'px"></i>');
    for (const m of [60, 30, 10]) if (left <= m && v9.lastLockSay > m) { v9.lastLockSay = m; say(s, 'OVERSEER · ' + m + ' SECONDS TO BURST', 3); v9Chirp(.9); }
    if (left <= 0) {
      v9.sentAt = t; v9Stats.sent = 1; v9HudSet('v9-signal', 'TRANSMISSION SENT');
      v9Morse([V9_TX.x, v9CellY(V9_TX) + 3, V9_TX.z], .06, '... --- ... ... --- ...', 880); v9Chirp(1.6);
      if (typeof v8RoundTitle === 'function') v8RoundTitle('TRANSMISSION SENT', 'SOMEONE HEARD · HOLD THE LINE');
      const st = document.getElementById('v9-sent-stats'); if (st) st.textContent = v9Card(s);
      const o = document.getElementById('v9-sent'); if (o) { o.classList.remove('hidden'); paused = true; clearInput(); releaseMouse(); audio && audio.mute(true); }
    }
  } else if (v9.sentAt >= 0 && t - v9.sentAt > 12) v9HudSet('v9-signal', '');
}
// ---------- ghosts (D3): seeded echoes of dead operators during intermission, drawn with V8's particle pool (kind 2) ----------
function v9GhostTick(s, dt) {
  const d = s.defense, t = s.time;
  if (d.intermission > 0 && v9.ghostWave !== d.wave && !v9.ghost) {
    v9.ghostWave = d.wave; const g = mulberry32(((s.seed || 0) + d.wave * 7919) >>> 0);
    if (g() < .35 && typeof pathBetween === 'function') {
      const p = s.p; // up to 3 seeded tries: a route from the player's own node out to a far point; the first 2 nodes are dropped so the echo starts ~4 m away and walks off
      for (let k = 0; k < 3 && !v9.ghost; k++) { const a = p.yaw + (g() - .5) * 2.6 + k * 2.1, r1 = 16 + g() * 10;
        const path = pathBetween({ x: p.x, y: p.y, z: p.z }, { x: p.x + Math.sin(a) * r1, y: p.y, z: p.z + Math.cos(a) * r1 });
        if (path && path.length > 4) { v9.ghost = { path: path.slice(2), i: 0, u: 0, t0: t, dur: 6 + g() * 3, said: false }; v9Stats.ghosts++; } }
    }
  }
  const gh = v9.ghost; if (!gh) return;
  const age = t - gh.t0; if (age > gh.dur || gh.i >= gh.path.length - 1) { v9.ghost = null; return; }
  const a = gh.path[gh.i], b = gh.path[gh.i + 1], len = Math.max(.01, Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z)); gh.u += 1.15 * dt / len;
  if (gh.u >= 1) { gh.i++; gh.u = 0; }
  const x = mix(a.x, b.x, clamp(gh.u, 0, 1)), y = mix(a.y, b.y, clamp(gh.u, 0, 1)), z = mix(a.z, b.z, clamp(gh.u, 0, 1)), fade = age < 1 ? age : age > gh.dur - 1.2 ? Math.max(0, (gh.dur - age) / 1.2) : 1;
  if (typeof v8Emit === 'function' && v9AnimRng() < .9 * fade) { const h = [.25, .7, 1.1, 1.45, 1.65][Math.floor(v9AnimRng() * 5)]; v8Emit(2, x, y + h, z, 0, .05, 0, .45, .55, .22); }
  if (!gh.said && age > 1.2 && Math.hypot(x - s.p.x, z - s.p.z) < 16) { gh.said = true; say(s, '…static… then nothing.', 3); }
}
// ---------- mutators (opt-in): lunar tide (C2), breach exposure (D1), weapon condition (D2) ----------
function v9MutatorTick(s, dt) {
  const d = s.defense, p = s.p, t = s.time;
  if (d.rocketLaunched && d.wave % 4 === 0 && d.wave !== v9.tideWave && d.intermission <= 0) { v9.tideWave = d.wave; v9.tideUntil = t + 25; say(s, 'LUNAR TIDE · LOW GRAVITY · 25 SECONDS', 4); v9Chirp(1); }
  if (t < v9.tideUntil && !p.ground && p.vy < -4.2) p.vy = -4.2; // fall-speed cap only (jump height / protected physics untouched)
  let exposed = false;
  for (const b of WORLD.breaches) if (d.boards[b.id] === 0 && b.inside && Math.hypot(b.inside.x - p.x, b.inside.z - p.z) < 8) { if (b.v9y == null) { const f = floorAt(b.inside.x, b.inside.z, b.y || 0); b.v9y = f ? f.y : 0; } if (Math.abs(b.v9y - p.y) < 2.2) { exposed = true; break; } }
  if (exposed && !d.perks.jug && p.hp > 1) { p.hp = Math.max(1, p.hp - .8 * dt); if (t - v9.exposeSay > 4) { v9.exposeSay = t; say(s, 'SUIT BREACH · REPAIR THE BARRIER', 2.5); } if (t - v9.exposeHiss > 1.1 && audio && audio.ctx && audio.active) { v9.exposeHiss = t; audio.burst(.9, .03, 2200, 'highpass', null, 0, .6); } }
}
// ---------- enemy feedback FX (S1-lite): particles only, read-only observer of s.enemies; AI / stats / VAT animation untouched ----------
function v9EnemyFx(s, dt) {
  if (typeof v8Emit !== 'function' || !s.enemies || !s.enemies.length) return;
  const p = s.p, map = v9.enemyMap, seq = ++v9.enemySeq; let budget = 10; // ≤10 particles per tick from this site; pool caps stay V8's (96/256/512)
  for (const e of s.enemies) {
    let m = map[e.id]; if (!m) m = map[e.id] = { hp: e.hp, x: e.x, z: e.z, stride: 0, dead: e.hp <= 0 };
    m.seen = seq;
    if (e.hp < m.hp && budget > 0) { // hit confirm: sparks at the chest; more on the killing blow, plus a dust kick at the feet
      const n = e.hp <= 0 ? 6 : 3;
      for (let i = 0; i < n && budget > 0; i++, budget--) { v8Emit(1, e.x, e.y + 1.15, e.z, (v9AnimRng() - .5) * 1.6, .8 + v9AnimRng() * 1.2, (v9AnimRng() - .5) * 1.6, .35, .5, .3); v9Stats.enemyFx++; }
      if (e.hp <= 0 && !m.dead) { m.dead = true; for (let i = 0; i < 6 && budget > 0; i++, budget--) { v8Emit(0, e.x, e.y + .25, e.z, (v9AnimRng() - .5) * 1.2, .5, (v9AnimRng() - .5) * 1.2, .9, 1.6, .5); v9Stats.enemyFx++; } }
    }
    m.hp = e.hp;
    if (e.hp > 0 && e.state !== 'breach') { // footfalls: a dust puff per stride within 30 m
      const d2 = (e.x - p.x) * (e.x - p.x) + (e.z - p.z) * (e.z - p.z); m.stride += Math.hypot(e.x - m.x, e.z - m.z);
      const stepLen = e.archetype === 'zombie-runner' ? .62 : .8;
      if (m.stride > stepLen) { m.stride = 0; if (d2 < 900 && budget > 0) { budget--; v8Emit(0, e.x, e.y + .04, e.z, 0, .35, 0, .55, .7, .35); v9Stats.enemyFx++; } }
    }
    m.x = e.x; m.z = e.z;
  }
  if ((seq & 63) === 0) for (const k in map) if (map[k].seen !== seq) delete map[k]; // forget bodies the base removed
}
// ---------- post-tick observer ----------
function v9AfterTick(s, dt) {
  if (!v9 || v9.s !== s) v9ResetRun(s);
  const t = s.time, p = s.p;
  if (!v9.seedNoted) { v9.seedNoted = true; const mode = Math.round(v9Num('v9seed')); if (mode > 0 && t < 2) say(s, (mode === 2 && s.seed !== v9DaySeed() ? 'CUSTOM SIGNAL · SEED ' : 'SIGNAL OF THE DAY · ') + s.seed, 4); }
  if (s.phase !== 'alive') { if (v9.photo) v9Photo(false); if (v9.lockAt >= 0 && v9.sentAt < 0) v9.interrupted = true; return; }
  // shots / hits (accuracy) from the base feedback record; heat + camera punch on new shots (V8 tracks shotAt from p.shotCd)
  if (s.feedback && s.feedback.at !== v9.lastFbAt) { v9.lastFbAt = s.feedback.at; v9.shots++; if (s.feedback.hit) v9.hits++; v9Stats.shots = v9.shots; v9Stats.hits = v9.hits; }
  if (typeof v8Vm !== 'undefined' && v8Vm.shotAt !== v9.lastShotAt) { v9.lastShotAt = v8Vm.shotAt; const w = p.weapon, h = V9_HEAT[w]; if (h) { v9.heat[w] = Math.min(1.25, (v9.heat[w] || 0) + h.per); v9.kickAt = t; v9.kickAmp = h.kick; v9.kickSign = v9AnimRng() < .5 ? -1 : 1; } }
  for (const w in v9.heat) if (v9.heat[w] > 0) v9.heat[w] = Math.max(0, v9.heat[w] - (V9_HEAT[w] ? V9_HEAT[w].cool : .4) * dt);
  if (p.hp < 35 && t - v9.lowHpAt > 60) { v9.lowHpAt = t; say(s, 'OVERSEER · THEY KNOW WHERE YOU ARE', 3); v9Chirp(.8); }
  v9Guard('quest', () => v9QuestTick(s, dt));
  v9Guard('ghost', () => v9GhostTick(s, dt));
  if (v9On('v9enemyfx')) v9Guard('enemyFx', () => v9EnemyFx(s, dt));
  if (v9On('v9mutators')) v9Guard('mutators', () => v9MutatorTick(s, dt));
  const cap = v9Num('v9captions'); if (cap !== v9.lastCapScale) { v9.lastCapScale = cap; document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--v9cap', String(clamp(cap, 1, 1.6))); }
}
function v9Tick(base, s, dt, controls) {

}

// ==== V10 — EXPANDED GROUNDS & RECORDED SOUND (installV10Hooks: wrappers + authorized world re-baseline) ====
// Orders implemented here: (a) every synthesized cue replaced by embedded real recordings (V10_AUDIO_DATA, decoded offline from base64,
// no network); (b) rooms physically enlarged by a piecewise-monotonic world warp applied while the V7 world and V8 architecture meshes

// (c) V8 door/breach clearance: static primitives crossing a doorway are dropped or split so nothing hangs in an opening;

const V10_BUILD = "cosmodrome-v10-20261014-expanded-grounds";
const V10_CUTS = {
  x: [[-17.6, 4], [-8.7, 4], [10.6, 3], [15.1, 2], [29.3, 4], [64.6, 5]],   // [line, metres inserted]
  z: [[-8.7, 4], [17.3, 3], [37.0, 4]]

const v10Mulberry = s => () => (s = s + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0, s = Math.imul(s ^ s >>> 15, 1 | s), s ^= s + Math.imul(s ^ s >>> 7, 61 | s), ((s ^ s >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296);

function v10Guard(name, fn) { try { return fn(); } catch (e) { v10Errors.push(name + ': ' + (e && e.message || e)); return undefined; } }

// ---------- world warp (piecewise translation; the anchor region never moves) ----------
function v10Off(axis, v) { let o = 0; const a = V10_ANCHOR[axis]; for (const [c, d] of V10_CUTS[axis]) { if (c > a) { if (v > c) o += d; } else if (v <= c) o -= d; } return o; }
const v10wx = x => x + v10Off('x', x), v10wz = z => z + v10Off('z', z);
function v10Inv(axis, w) { // inverse map for probes/poses: warped -> original (gaps collapse onto the cut line)
  let lo = -400, hi = 400; for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) { const m = (lo + hi) / 2; (m + v10Off(axis, m) < w ? (lo = m) : (hi = m)); } return (lo + hi) / 2;
}
// Rigid-or-stretch decision for a primitive from its axis-aligned extents: thin or small pieces translate whole, long pieces stretch.
function v10RigidAxis(ext, ey, other) { return ext < 1.0 || (ext < 2.6 && ey < 3.0) || (ext < 3.2 && ey < 1.2 && other < 3.2); }
function v10RigidFor(x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1) {
  if (v10ForceStretch) return null;
  const ex = x1 - x0, ez = z1 - z0, ey = y1 - y0, cx = (x0 + x1) / 2, cz = (z0 + z1) / 2;
  const rx = v10RigidAxis(ex, ey, ez), rz = v10RigidAxis(ez, ey, ex);
  if (!rx && !rz) return null;
  v10Stats.rigidPrims++;
  return { dx: rx ? v10wx(cx) - cx : null, dz: rz ? v10wz(cz) - cz : null };
}
function v10WarpPoint(p, r) { return [r && r.dx != null ? p[0] + r.dx : v10wx(p[0]), p[1], r && r.dz != null ? p[2] + r.dz : v10wz(p[2])]; }
// Door / breach clearance zones (unwarped coordinates; the V8 architecture builds against the unwarped snapshot)
function v10BuildDoorZones(W) {
  const z = [];
  for (const d of W.doors) { const hw = (d.width || 4.65) / 2 + 1.0, n = 2.4, y = d.y || 0; z.push(d.axis === 'x' ? { x0: d.x - n, x1: d.x + n, z0: d.z - hw, z1: d.z + hw, y0: y + .25, y1: y + 4.05, id: d.id } : { x0: d.x - hw, x1: d.x + hw, z0: d.z - n, z1: d.z + n, y0: y + .25, y1: y + 4.05, id: d.id }); }
  for (const b of W.breaches) { const hw = (b.width || 2.8) / 2 + .6, n = 1.6, y = b.y || 0; z.push(b.axis === 'x' ? { x0: b.x - n, x1: b.x + n, z0: b.z - hw, z1: b.z + hw, y0: y + .25, y1: y + 3.4, id: b.id } : { x0: b.x - hw, x1: b.x + hw, z0: b.z - n, z1: b.z + n, y0: y + .25, y1: y + 3.4, id: b.id }); }
  return z;
}
const v10ZoneHit = (x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1) => v10DoorZones.find(q => x1 > q.x0 && x0 < q.x1 && z1 > q.z0 && z0 < q.z1 && y1 > q.y0 && y0 < q.y1) || null;
function v10InstallMeshWrappers() {
  const P = Mesh.prototype, tri0 = P.tri, box0 = P.box, bevel0 = P.bevel, cyl0 = P.cylinder, sph0 = P.sphere;
  P.tri = function (a, b, c, n, mat, col, uv) {
    if (!v10WarpOn) return tri0.call(this, a, b, c, n, mat, col, uv);
    if (v10V8Build && mat !== V8_MAT.SCREEN) { const cx = (a[0] + b[0] + c[0]) / 3, cy = (a[1] + b[1] + c[1]) / 3, cz = (a[2] + b[2] + c[2]) / 3; if (v10ZoneHit(cx, cx, cy, cy, cz, cz)) { v10Stats.culledTris++; return; } }
    v10Stats.warpedTris++;

  };
  // V8 flat quads (screen glass, wall strips, gloss bands, floor/ceiling strips, glass panes) push raw vertices through v8Vert, bypassing Mesh.tri: warp them under the same rules (rigid offset when a screen set one, otherwise per-vertex)
  v8Vert = ((o) => function (m, p, n, uv, mat, c) {

      }

  };

// ---------- WORLD tables ----------
function v10WarpBox(o) {
  const r = v10RigidFor(o.x0, o.x1, o.y0 == null ? 0 : o.y0, o.y1 == null ? (o.y == null ? 0 : o.y) : o.y1, o.z0, o.z1);
  const x0 = r && r.dx != null ? o.x0 + r.dx : v10wx(o.x0), x1 = r && r.dx != null ? o.x1 + r.dx : v10wx(o.x1);
  const z0 = r && r.dz != null ? o.z0 + r.dz : v10wz(o.z0), z1 = r && r.dz != null ? o.z1 + r.dz : v10wz(o.z1);
  o.x0 = x0; o.x1 = x1; o.z0 = z0; o.z1 = z1;
}
function v10WarpWorld(W) {
  for (const c of W.colliders) v10WarpBox(c);
  for (const f of W.floors) v10WarpBox(f);
  for (const d of W.doors) { d.x = v10wx(d.x); d.z = v10wz(d.z); }
  for (const b of W.breaches) { b.x = v10wx(b.x); b.z = v10wz(b.z); if (b.inside) { b.inside.x = v10wx(b.inside.x); b.inside.z = v10wz(b.inside.z); } if (b.spawn) { b.spawn.x = v10wx(b.spawn.x); b.spawn.z = v10wz(b.spawn.z); } }
  for (const m of W.machines) { m.x = v10wx(m.x); m.z = v10wz(m.z); }
  for (const g of W.gunRacks) { g.x = v10wx(g.x); g.z = v10wz(g.z); }
  for (const p of W.pads) { p.x = v10wx(p.x); p.z = v10wz(p.z); }
  for (const l of W.lights) if (l.p) { l.p[0] = v10wx(l.p[0]); l.p[2] = v10wz(l.p[2]); }
  for (const s of W.signs || []) if (s.p) { s.p[0] = v10wx(s.p[0]); s.p[2] = v10wz(s.p[2]); }
  W.extent.x = [v10wx(W.extent.x[0]), v10wx(W.extent.x[1])]; W.extent.z = [v10wz(W.extent.z[0]), v10wz(W.extent.z[1])];
  W.playableExtent.x = [v10wx(W.playableExtent.x[0]), v10wx(W.playableExtent.x[1])]; W.playableExtent.z = [v10wz(W.playableExtent.z[0]), v10wz(W.playableExtent.z[1])];
  W.nodes = v10BuildNav(W);
  W.geometryRevision = (W.geometryRevision || '') + '+v10-expanded-grounds';

}
// Navigation lattice: a port of the V7 grid rules (2 m lattice, body radius .32 / height 1.85, 16-step link walks, ramp-foot nodes).
function v10BuildNav(W) {
  const floors = W.floors, cols = W.colliders;
  const surfaces = (x, z) => { const m = new Map(); for (const f of floors) { if (x < f.x0 || x > f.x1 || z < f.z0 || z > f.z1) continue; const y = floorY(f, x, z); m.set(Math.round(1e3 * y), { ...f, y }); } return [...m.values()].sort((a, b) => a.y - b.y); };
  const surface = (x, z, a) => { const o = surfaces(x, z).filter(s => s.y <= a + .34); return o[o.length - 1] || null; };
  const sBlocked = (x, y, z) => cols.some(o => x + .32 > o.x0 && x - .32 < o.x1 && z + .32 > o.z0 && z - .32 < o.z1 && y + 1.85 > o.y0 + .04 && y + .18 < o.y1) || floors.some(f => floorBodyBlocked(f, x, y, z, .32, 1.85));
  const nodes = [], grid = new Map(), pe = W.playableExtent;
  let xs = Math.floor(pe.x[0]) + 1; if (Math.abs(xs % 2) !== 1) xs -= 1;   // odd x like the V7 lattice
  let zs = Math.floor(pe.z[0]); if (zs % 2 !== 0) zs -= 1;                   // even z
  for (let ix = 0, x = xs; x <= pe.x[1] + 1; x += 2, ix++) for (let iz = 0, z = zs; z <= pe.z[1] + 2; z += 2, iz++) {
    const cell = [];
    for (const s of surfaces(x, z)) { if (sBlocked(x, s.y, z) || surface(x, z, s.y).y > s.y + .04) continue; const n = { i: nodes.length, x, y: s.y, z, links: [], ix, iz }; nodes.push(n); cell.push(n); }
    if (cell.length) grid.set(ix + ',' + iz, cell);
  }
  const walk = (e, o, steps) => { if (Math.abs(e.y - o.y) > 1.4) return false; let a = e.y; for (let i = 1; i <= steps; i++) { const n = i / steps, sx = mix(e.x, o.x, n), sz = mix(e.z, o.z, n), c = surface(sx, sz, a); if (!c || sBlocked(sx, c.y, sz) || Math.abs(c.y - a) > .32) return false; a = c.y; } return Math.abs(a - o.y) < .04; };
  for (const e of nodes) for (const [dx, dz] of [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]]) for (const o of grid.get((e.ix + dx) + ',' + (e.iz + dz)) || []) if (walk(e, o, 16)) e.links.push(o.i);
  const extra = [];
  for (const f of floors.filter(f => f.axis === 'z' && f.y1 > f.y0)) for (const x of [f.x0 - .75, (f.x0 + f.x1) / 2, f.x1 + .75]) { const z = f.z0 - .9, o = surface(x, z, f.y0); if (!o || sBlocked(x, o.y, z)) continue; const n = { i: nodes.length, x, y: o.y, z, links: [], ix: null, iz: null }; nodes.push(n); extra.push(n); }
  for (const e of extra) for (const t of nodes) e === t || Math.hypot(e.x - t.x, e.z - t.z) > 3 || (walk(e, t, 20) && !e.links.includes(t.i) && e.links.push(t.i), walk(t, e, 20) && !t.links.includes(e.i) && t.links.push(e.i));
  return nodes;
}

const V10_SETS = {}; for (const id in V10_AUDIO_DATA) { const m = /^(.*)_\d+$/.exec(id); const k = m ? m[1] : id; (V10_SETS[k] = V10_SETS[k] || []).push(id); }

function v10Decode(a) {
  const ctx = a.ctx; a.v10buf = a.v10buf || {}; a.v10onset = a.v10onset || {}; let pending = 0;
  for (const id in V10_AUDIO_DATA) {

    pending++;
    try {
      const b64 = V10_AUDIO_DATA[id], bin = atob(b64), bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length); for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) bytes[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
      const done = buf => { a.v10buf[id] = buf; const d = buf.getChannelData(0); let k = 0; while (k < d.length && Math.abs(d[k]) < .02) k++; a.v10onset[id] = Math.max(0, k / buf.sampleRate - .004); v10Stats.decoded++; };
      const fail = () => { v10Stats.decodeFailed++; };
      const p = ctx.decodeAudioData(bytes.buffer, done, fail); if (p && p.catch) p.catch(fail);
    } catch (e) { v10Stats.decodeFailed++; }
  }
  v10Stats.clips = pending;

// play a recording: positional via the V7 route() (HRTF panner, occlusion low-pass, room send); returns the voice or null
function v10Play(a, key, pos, o = {}) {
  if (!a || !a.ctx || !a.active || !a.v10buf) return null;
  const id = v10Pick.call(a, key), buf = id && a.v10buf[id]; if (!buf) return null;
  a.reserve(); v10Stats.plays++;
  const ctx = a.ctx, t = ctx.currentTime + (o.delay || 0), src = ctx.createBufferSource(), g = ctx.createGain();
  src.buffer = buf; src.loop = !!o.loop; src.playbackRate.value = (o.rate || 1) * (o.jitter ? 1 + (v10AudioRng() - .5) * o.jitter : 1);
  const gain = (o.gain == null ? .5 : o.gain) * .9;
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(1e-4, t); g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(1e-4, gain), t + (o.attack || .004));
  const r = a.route(pos || null, o.wet == null ? 1 : o.wet), nodes = [src, g, ...r.nodes]; let head = g;
  if (o.lowpass) { const f = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); f.type = 'lowpass'; f.frequency.value = o.lowpass; f.Q.value = .5; src.connect(f); f.connect(g); nodes.push(f); }
  else src.connect(g);
  g.connect(r.input);
  const onset = a.v10onset[id] || 0, len = buf.duration / src.playbackRate.value;
  let end;
  if (o.loop) end = t + 3600; else { const dur = o.dur ? Math.min(o.dur, len) : len; end = t + dur; if (o.dur && o.dur < len) { g.gain.setValueAtTime(gain, Math.max(t, end - .06)); g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(1e-4, end); } }
  a.own(src, nodes, end + .05);
  try { src.start(t, Math.min(onset, Math.max(0, buf.duration - .01))); if (!o.loop) src.stop(end + .05); } catch (e) { return null; }
  return { src, gain: g, panner: r.panner, nodes, at: t };
}
function v10InstallAudio() {

    });
  };

  P.update = function (e) {
    if (!this.ctx || !this.active) return;
    const t = this.ctx, a = e.p; this.listen(e);
    for (const v of [...this.transients.values()]) t.currentTime > v.until + .35 && v.clean();
    const zone = zoneAt(e), quiet = !!ROOM_PROFILES[zone]?.quiet, outdoor = this.room === 'long';
    v10Guard('ambience', () => {
      const amb = this.v10amb; if (!amb) return;
      if (!amb.started && this.v10buf && this.v10buf.wind_loop) { amb.started = true; const src = t.createBufferSource(); src.buffer = this.v10buf.wind_loop; src.loop = true; src.connect(amb.out); src.connect(amb.lp); src.start(); amb.src = src; }
      amb.out.gain.setTargetAtTime(quiet ? .004 : outdoor ? .11 : .03, t.currentTime, .8);
      amb.in.gain.setTargetAtTime(quiet ? .01 : outdoor ? .03 : .09, t.currentTime, .8);
    });
    if (e.time > this.nextBreath) { const s = (100 - a.stamina) / 100; if (s > .35 || a.injury > 0) play(this, 'breath', null, { gain: .03 + .1 * s + .02 * a.injury, rate: 1 + .25 * s, wet: .25 }); this.nextBreath = e.time + Math.max(mix(3.8, 2.4, s), 3.6 / (1 + .25 * s) * .95); }
    if (e.time > this.nextDrip) this.nextDrip = e.time + 4 + 11 * v10FxRng();   // no field recording of a drip was sourced: cue retired (kept the schedule for parity)
    if (e.time > this.nextCreak && !quiet) { play(this, 'creak', [a.x - 2, a.y + 4, a.z + 6], { gain: .05, rate: .65, jitter: .15 }); this.nextCreak = e.time + 12 + 17 * v10FxRng(); }
  };

  v9Morse = function (pos, gain, pattern) { if (!audio || !audio.ctx || !audio.active) return 0; let at = 0; for (const c of pattern) { if (c === ' ') { at += .2; continue; } const d = c === '-' ? .17 : .06; play(audio, c === '-' ? // death / crawler vocals (recorded) driven from the sim: a zombie that just died or just lost its legs
function v10EnemyVocals(s) {
  if (!audio || !audio.ctx || !audio.active || !s || !s.enemies) return;
  for (const e of s.enemies) {
    if (e.archetype === 'space-monkey') continue;
    if (e.hp <= 0 && !e.v10Died) { e.v10Died = true; if (e.deadAt != null && s.time - e.deadAt < 1) v10Play(audio, 'z_die', [e.x, e.y + .6, e.z], { gain: .5, jitter: .1 }); }
    if (e.crawler && !e.v10Crawl) { e.v10Crawl = true; if (e.hp > 0) v10Play(audio, 'z_hit', [e.x, e.y + .3, e.z], { gain: .45, rate: .9 }); }
  }
}
function installV10Hooks() {
  v10Guard('mesh', v10InstallMeshWrappers);
  v10Guard('world', v10InstallWorldHooks);
  v10Guard('poly', v10InstallPolyHooks);
  v10Guard('audio', v10InstallAudio);
  tick = ((o) => function (s, dt, inp) { const r = o(s, dt, inp); v10Guard('vocals', () => v10EnemyVocals(s)); return r; })(tick);
}

installV5Hooks(),installV6Hooks(),installV7Hooks(),installV8Hooks(),installV9Hooks(),installV10Hooks(),boot();})();
